parameters.name: fogMode
parameters.description: camera-visible surface depth cueing; none disables fog and ignores inactive inputs

parameters.name: fogDistanceMetric
parameters.description: world distance: viewDepth is nonnegative depth along committed camera forward from camera position; rayDistance is distance from the original camera-sample ray origin

parameters.name: fogColorSource
parameters.description: constant uses fogColor; background uses the unfogged visible backdrop RGB at the original camera sample and ignores fogColor

parameters.name: fogColor
parameters.description: finite nonnegative linear RGB, including HDR values above one; used only by constant color source

parameters.name: fogStart
parameters.description: finite nonnegative world distance; used only by linear mode, ignored by exp and exp2

parameters.name: fogEnd
parameters.description: finite world distance strictly greater than fogStart; used only by linear mode, ignored by exp and exp2

parameters.name: fogDensity
parameters.description: finite nonnegative inverse-world-distance curve coefficient; used only by exp and exp2, ignored by linear; not a physical medium coefficient
